integrity: Proof is analytic; finite checker comparisons corroborate kernel identities but do not independently certify the theorem.
limitations: Exact results apply only to real periodic BV data, one implicit-Euler resolvent of the unit-circle Laplacian, and unweighted L2 error; historical priority remains conditional on available literature.
title: A sharp bifurcation of worst BV errors for periodic implicit-Euler heat smoothing
